description: a dense thicket of waist-high ferns under dark spruces at night, fern fronds hiding the ground completely, the pale shape of a huge praying mantis rising above the ferns, the glossy black coil of a giant millipede between the leaves, cold mist, centered composition for a round medallion frame, pixel art scene, muted dark palette of fern greens, spruce greens and night blues, soft light, no text, no border, no people
